prompts.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather / stylized-concept. Produce one polished 16:9 art-direction paint-over of the attached ACTUAL GAME SCREENSHOT, for collaborative visual review. The screenshot is the edit target, not just loose inspiration. Preserve the camera framing, exact small central red-and-ivory spacecraft identity, size, position and silhouette, and the HUD layout, text, icons and positions. Do not add any ships, terrain, structures, moons, rings or decorative UI. Edit the background art and the foreground ship's illumination. Keep the game's stylized hand-painted/cel-shaded visual language, with soft painterly cosmic clouds. This is a playable scene, not a splash illustration. The current image is overbright and the ship disappears. Rebuild the value hierarchy: deep rich shadows over most of the frame, restrained midtone color in the background, little local color emission and very little bloom. The ship should read first at its actual tiny gameplay size, through a restrained neutral ivory key light and a subtle colored edge, with readable red armor and black gaps. Do not make the whole picture brighter to light the ship. Maintain rich saturated color in shadow without gray haze, chalky pastel washes, crushed all-black emptiness, huge white glow, gritty noise or photorealistic NASA photography. Keep HUD unchanged. Output only the single revised game view; no labels or comparison layout. Warm nebula direction: preserve the user's scarlet, russet, amber, coral-orange and peach-pink palette. Replace the blanket of luminous orange/cream cloud with spacious deep oxblood and dark umber clouds, with red-orange light glowing INSIDE a few folded clouds, thin muted coral-pink edges and occasional amber detail. Most cloud masses should be in rich dark midtones, not beige and not gray. Keep a calm dark warm region immediately behind the ship, with broad asymmetrical sweeping cloud forms around it. Suggest scale, depth and slow flowing turbulence. Keep all shadows warm, no blue/purple recolor. Avoid a bright central opening or bright clouds filling the entire frame. Cosmic, moody, rich and inviting rather than a fiery explosion.
